dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.sessions.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND status = 'running') AS "Active", (SELECT count(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND status = 'sleeping') AS "Idle", (SELECT count(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1) AS "Total"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.cpu.label
dashboard.query: SELECT SUM(s.total_cpu_usage_ms) / (10.0 * MAX(i.cpu_count)) AS "SQL Server" FROM sys.dm_os_schedulers s CROSS JOIN sys.dm_os_sys_info i WHERE s.status = N'VISIBLE ONLINE'

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.requests.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE object_name LIKE N'%:SQL Statistics%' AND counter_name = N'Batch Requests/sec') AS "Batches", (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE object_name LIKE N'%:Databases%' AND counter_name = N'Transactions/sec' AND instance_name = N'_Total') AS "Transactions", (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE object_name LIKE N'%:SQL Statistics%' AND counter_name = N'SQL Compilations/sec') AS "Compilations"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.waits.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sys.dm_os_waiting_tasks wt JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = wt.session_id WHERE s.is_user_process = 1) AS "Waiting tasks", (SELECT count(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0) AS "Blocked"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.io.label
dashboard.query: SELECT SUM(num_of_bytes_read) AS "Read", SUM(num_of_bytes_written) AS "Write" FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL)

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.locks.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE object_name LIKE N'%:Locks%' AND counter_name = N'Lock Waits/sec' AND instance_name = N'_Total') AS "Lock waits", (SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE object_name LIKE N'%:Locks%' AND counter_name = N'Number of Deadlocks/sec' AND instance_name = N'_Total') AS "Deadlocks"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.sqlserver.cacheHit.label
dashboard.query: SELECT CAST(100.0 * a.cntr_value / NULLIF(b.cntr_value, 0) AS decimal(5, 1)) AS "Cache hit" FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters a JOIN sys.dm_os_performance_counters b ON b.object_name = a.object_name AND b.counter_name = N'Buffer cache hit ratio base' WHERE a.object_name LIKE N'%:Buffer Manager%' AND a.counter_name = N'Buffer cache hit ratio'

dashboard.label: %dashboard.postgresql.waits.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event_type IS NULL) AS "CPU", (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock') AS "Lock", (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event_type = 'IO') AS "IO", (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event_type NOT IN ('Lock', 'IO')) AS "Other"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.postgresql.locks.label
dashboard.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks WHERE granted) AS "Granted", (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks WHERE NOT granted) AS "Waiting"

dashboard.label: %dashboard.postgresql.cacheHit.label
dashboard.query: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(blks_hit) / NULLIF(sum(blks_hit) + sum(blks_read), 0), 1) AS "Cache hit" FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_database
